/ static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\nvoid initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B, \n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            C[i * N + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                   const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n    \n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n            \n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            \n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n            \n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<double> A(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(N * N);\n    \n    // Initialize matrices\n    printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initMatrix(A, N);\n    initMatrix(B, N);\n    \n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS\n    double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(C, \"MatrixC\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(A, B, C, N);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: Out-of-range staging entries are zero, which leaves\n// the accumulators unchanged.","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                       \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg13F1GLwkvMKtoU25QnM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. It is in `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt`, and the executable is still `matmul`. It builds with no warnings, and its output matches the original bit for bit at most sizes. Nothing was committed.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI:** rows of A and C are split into contiguous blocks, one per GPU across the cluster, so a rank with more GPUs gets more rows. Each rank holds the full B. Rank 0 gathers C only when `-v` or `-r` needs it.\n- **OpenMP:** one host thread per local GPU drives that GPU's transfers and kernel. GPUs on a node are shared round-robin among its ranks.\n- **CUDA:** a register-tiled 64×64 DGEMM kernel with shared-memory staging. Each element accumulates over k in ascending order, as the original does. Page-locked host buffers are used for faster copies, and CUDA context setup is excluded from the timing.\n- **CMake:** adds the CUDA language, MPI, OpenMP, and the CUDA runtime, and keeps the original flags. The CUDA architecture defaults to `native`, and the minimum CMake version is now 3.24.\n\n**Verification (4× RTX 3090)**\n- The `-r` hash matches the original for N = 1, 3, 130, 512, 1000, and 2048 at 1, 2, and 4 ranks. It also matches with 8 ranks on 4 GPUs (idle ranks) and 3 ranks (uneven split).\n- N=5 and N=77 differ from the original in 4 and some elements, respectively, by one ULP. The original's host loop mixes fused and unfused multiply-add per element, depending on which loop path GCC takes. Validation still passes.\n- N=2048: 37 ms, versus 98,881 ms for the original.\n- N=8192 on 4 GPUs: about 975 GFLOPS.\n- The `-v` and `-r` paths, `-h`, bad options, and N=0 all behave as before.\n- I did not exercise the validation-failure exit path.\n\n**Choices to review**\n- **No FMA:** the kernel uses `__dmul_rn`/`__dadd_rn` to match the original's rounding. On these GeForce cards, that roughly halves peak throughput compared with `fma`. If raw speed matters more than matching the original's hashes, switch to `fma` in `gemmKernel`.\n- **Validation at N=0:** the original crashed with a division by zero; the new code reports PASSED.\n- **Extra output:** a `Devices:` line is printed. The timing line keeps the original integer-ms format, so small N shows 0–3 ms.\n- **Build requirement:** `native` needs a visible GPU at configure time. Set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` explicitly when building on a login node."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2417,"cache_read_input_tokens":92901,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2417},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"fef98c61-461f-4463-8383-6bc41dec95c2","uuid":"7cefc1bc-8bd6-439d-8a4e-c5b21d89cc6b","timestamp":"2026-10-13T22:39:25.415Z","request_id":"req_011Cg13EzkpuwW8QSV845gEA"}
